featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm hooked on JJ Desserts & Fries in Malad! I tried their G.O.A.T fries on my first visit and they were amazing. Whether you're craving something sweet or savory, JJ Desserts has you covered with their delectable offerings.

featured_reviews.review_text: This is undoubtedly the best ice cream parlour I've visited till date! It's located in Evershine Nagar Malad. They have varieties of ice cream for reasonable prices. The ice creams taste really amazing, giving a tough competition to the other well known ice cream brands. featured_reviews.name: Voracious Blogger
featured_reviews.review_text:
So today I visited Apsara Icecreams - Since 1971 (Malad West)
Everyone knows this well icecream brand and most of you have tried this!
Those who have not tried Apsara Icecream are missing the seasonal as well as common flavours for icecream
The ambiemce was pretty.It had 2 pairs of well maintained sofa and some extra chairs to sit and enjoy the icecreams
The interiors are very well designed and some of the part is in renowation to make it more beautiful
I tried : 1) Guava Masala - Perfectly tasting guava with the pieces of guava inside the icecream with the masala powder sprinkled over it tasted perfectly
2) Belgian Bites - Made up of belgian chocolate having cholate chips and pieces made it tastier then expected
3) Pani Puri icecream - This is my personal favourite as this pani puri icecream tasted like a real pani puri. Over the scoop of icecream there were crush pieces of puri which made it look perfect
4) Blueberry Cheesecake Icecream - This icecream is true heaven for those who love berries. It also had some pieces of berries in it which made it delicious
5) Funky Ferrero and Cookies and cream icecream - I tried trying them in a single cup with half scoop. Cookies and cream tasted like oreo cookies and Funky ferrero had pieces of ferrero chocolate in it
The staff was very quick and gave me some fantastic taste to try!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Naturals Ice Cream, which is situated just beside our office, so it’s usually a go-to place for many of my colleagues after lunch.

I’m honestly not a big ice cream person, but I still end up going there often with my friends because they really enjoy it.

Among the flavors I’ve tried, I really liked the Tender Coconut ice cream. The little crunch of coconut malai in it makes it taste really nice and refreshing.

I also liked the Guava flavor, especially because of that pinch of masala, which gives it a unique taste.

Other than these two, for me, the rest of the flavors were just okay-okay, but if you enjoy ice cream, it’s definitely a nice place to visit and spend time with friends.

Don’t know why there are mixed reviews about this place! Honestly, one of the best I’ve cream spots in Mumbai. The moment the ice cream melts into your mouth, you can feel the richness and quality.
Pistachio baklava was sooo incredibly delicious!

featured_reviews.name: Silvia Mercia
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the Classic Amaras, Filter Kappi and Tender coconut. Good flavours. Kappi was my favourite out of the three. However, Felt it was priced steep and it would have been wonderful to have a cone to go…..

featured_reviews.review_text: Really liked the nutella cookie with hazelnut icecream... The cookie is so perfect!!!

featured_reviews.name: Ragini Kanani
featured_reviews.review_text: The icecream looks nice, tastes better, but when I had the entire scoop by myself, it was way too salty for me, I had paan kajukatli icecream. My husband took chocochip cookie with vanilla ice-cream, the cookie was also very salty.

featured_reviews.name: Phoramd Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: Appreciate the effort but can work on taste and service. Today one cant just have different flavors but average taste and service. Hope they catch up soon.

featured_reviews.name: Manan Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Average experience overall. It was refreshing to see the founder at the bill counter but I couldn't get the hype.
The ice-creams were over sweet and just average, nothing extraordinary.
